item.title: Director of Product
item.description:
About ApprovalMax:

ApprovalMax is a B2B SaaS platform that puts finance teams in control of their approvals. We sit at the heart of how accountants and mid-market finance teams run Accounts Payable, with deep integrations into Xero, QuickBooks Online and NetSuite. We are a profitable, scaling company, and we are building AI deep into our product.

The role:

We’re looking for a Director of Product to own our core approval workflow surfaces, the implementation of our AI strategy across workflows, our integrations with accounting systems, and our new Expense Management product. This is a player-coach role. You’ll lead two experienced Product Managers on those lines while personally owning major initiatives, so we’re looking for someone who’s done this before and wants to stay close to the product.

You’ll help shape the future of our product, making it easier for users to automate more of their work through trusted rule-based and AI-driven solutions while staying in control. You’ll also play a key role in shaping how our Product function operates and how we bring our products to market.


What you'll do:

  • Own the roadmap, delivery and quality of our approval-workflow product, AI delivery, accounting-system integrations and expense management, and lead the big initiatives within them.

  • Lead and develop two Product Managers and own accurate reporting, milestones and deliverables.

  • Drive automation and autonomy - design, ship and refine rule-based and AI automation that users trust, so they delegate more while staying in control.

  • Prepare the business case to justify future roadmap investments and work with product marketing to deliver betas and launches.

  • Own how we hear and act on customer feedback and how the entire Product team reports on meeting customer needs.

  • Be a guiding example of best practice for how Product learns user needs, builds roadmaps, runs product operations, reads the competitive landscape and takes products to market.

What we're looking for:

  • Strong product leadership. You've led product squads and managed Product Managers, and can be trusted to run an area and make the call.

  • Workflow, Expense and/or spend-management product experience.

  • Strong product operations. You can lift roadmapping and delivery hygiene across a team.

  • Commercial and go-to-market tradecraft, building the business case, modelling the investment, and planning betas and launches.

  • A deep workflow product background, ideally from the accounting or spend ecosystem (Sage, Xero, QBO, Lightyear, Expensify, Dext or similar), with first-hand understanding of what finance teams and accountants need.

  • Strong automation and AI product experience. You've designed and shipped rule-based and agentic AI automation that users trust.

  • Comfortable working within an established Product Manager and Product Engineer delivery flow. You are senior and autonomous, able to own an area and set its direction.

  • B2B SaaS experience in a scale-up environment.

Nice to have:

  • Fintech, accounting or finance-adjacent domain beyond the core accounting systems.

What we offer:

  • Salary: Up to £130,000, dependent on experience and location.

  • Healthcare: Fully funded healthcare cover.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Health & Wellbeing Benefit Stipend.

  • Home Office Setup: One-off £500 reimbursement following successful completion of probation.

  • Annual Leave: 26 days of paid time off + 1 day birthday leave

  • Service-years recognition financial reward

  • Growing international business with 20,000+ subscribers

item.title: Revenue Operations Specialist
item.description:
Company Description:
ApprovalMax is award-winning B2B software used by businesses around the world to optimize their money-out processes. It streamlines the approval process for decision-makers by replacing paper and email approvals with automated workflows, and integrates seamlessly with platforms such as Xero, QuickBooks Online, and Oracle NetSuite to unlock powerful efficiencies for approvers and finance teams. The company is globally recognized, trusted by over 20,000 businesses globally, a 2026 G2 Leader with 4.8/5 rating and has won ‘Xero App Partner of the Year’ multiple times since 2020 in different countries.

As a Revenue Operations Specialist, you will support revenue growth and improve internal processes across the business. Reporting to the Revenue Operations Manager, you’ll play a key role in advancing our revenue operations motion and collaborating with key stakeholders across marketing, sales, customer success, finance, operations and support. The primary focus on scaling our customer success and support processes and automations, delivering insights and recommendations that drive revenue growth and retention across our customer portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process Building and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with commercial stakeholders, notably customer success and support leadership to define requirements and propose and implement scalable, automated solutions.

  • Continue to scale existing revenue operations processes, proactively identifying inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work closely with teammates to implement improvements across both the CRM and other revenue tools to maintain an integrated revenue operations motion.

Insights & Recommendations

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to gather and consolidate relevant data across multiple sources, including CRM systems, sales tools, marketing automation platforms, and other databases.

  • Leverage data-driven findings to propose actionable recommendations that support revenue growth and operational excellence.

  • Develop reports, dashboards, and presentations for commercial team members and leadership.

  • Track and measure the impact of implemented changes against key performance indicators.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay up to date with industry best practices, emerging trends, and new technologies within revenue operations.

  • Identify and action opportunities for continuous internal process improvement and scalability within the revenue operations team.

  • Maintain and enhance CRM data integrity, reporting structures, and data infrastructure to support better decision-making and performance tracking.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Marketing, or equivalent experience.

  • Deep experience with HubSpot as a CRM, with the ability to work with custom objects, dashboards and reporting, and to build, test and troubleshoot complex workflows (HubSpot certifications preferred).

  • 2+ years of experience working in a high growth setting, ideally within SaaS or consulting environment, with a preference for formal revenue operations experience

  • Thoughtful written and verbal communication skills, capable of documenting logic clearly and working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and generate actionable insights.

  • Interest (and/or experience) working with different revenue tools, including Clay, Attention, Intercom, BI tools, SQL and AI

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities, with a proactive, problem-solving mindset and a focus on continuous improvement.

What we Offer:

  • Salary: Up to CAD $95,000 base salary + variable bonus, dependent on experience.

  • Fully funded Sterling Healthcare Plan.

  • Pension: 6% employer contribution to the Canada Pension Plan (CPP).

  • Health & Wellbeing: Health & Wellbeing Benefit Stipend.

  • Home Office Setup: One-off £500 reimbursement (CAD equivalent) following successful completion of probation.

  • Annual Leave: 26 days of paid time off + 1 day birthday leave.

  • Service-years recognition financial reward.

  • Growing international business with 20,000+ subscribers.

item.title: Director of Marketing (Global)
item.description:
ABOUT APPROVALMAX

ApprovalMax is a B2B SaaS platform that automates approval workflows for finance and accounting teams. We sit between accounting software (Xero, QuickBooks Online, Oracle NetSuite) and every outgoing payment, giving the office of the CFO control, segregation of duties, and a clean audit trail. Founded in 2016, we serve 20,000+ customers across EMEA, APAC, and AMER, with revenue hubs in the UK, Toronto, Cape Town, and Brisbane. Ours is a high-volume, low-ACV motion — we win by acquiring efficiently at scale, converting trials to paying customers, and expanding accounts.

THE ROLE

We are hiring a Director of Marketing (Global) to own and drive Marketing across all of our markets. You’ll drive capital-efficient growth by acquiring new customers, building the brand, and running the programmes, campaigns and customer marketing that fuel it.

This is a builder's role for an operator who thinks in numbers. You will own acquisition strategy end to end, from channel mix and budget allocation to campaign execution and be measured on pipeline, trial volume, conversion to paid, and CAC efficiency across regions.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

  • Global acquisition. Manage the global marketing strategy for new-logo acquisition across AMER, EMEA, and APAC, with clear regional plans for delivering qualified trials, pipeline, and revenue growth.

  • Funnel performance. Own performance across the marketing funnel from demand generation through trial starts and trial-to-paid conversion with clear accountability for CAC, payback, pipeline contribution, and conversion.

  • Marketing investment. Manage the global marketing budget and channel mix, continuously allocating investment towards the activities and markets generating the strongest commercial returns.

  • Operating rhythm. Establish forecasting, reporting, experimentation, and a clear cadence of acquisition KPIs, providing visibility and accountability to the CRO and Senior Leadership Team.

  • Team leadership. Lead, develop, and hold accountable a globally distributed marketing team, creating clear priorities, ownership, and ways of working across regions and time zones.

  • Brand and positioning. Lead the development of ApprovalMax's brand, positioning, messaging, and visual identity — ensuring a consistent and compelling presence across markets and customer touchpoints.

  • Product marketing and GTM. Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and other cross-functional teams on product positioning, launches, go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, and the handoff from marketing-generated demand through to revenue.

  • Campaigns and channels. Lead integrated campaigns across performance marketing, content, SEO/SEM, email, paid digital, social, webinars, events, and other relevant channels, ensuring activity is commercially focused and measurable.

  • Partner and ecosystem marketing. Develop marketing initiatives with partners and within the wider accounting and finance ecosystem to increase reach, strengthen brand visibility, and generate customer demand.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • US acquisition marketing. Non-negotiable. Proven experience driving customer acquisition in the US market.

  • Remote team leadership. Demonstrated success managing a distributed, remote marketing team across regions and time zones.

  • High-volume motion. A track record of marketing a low-ACV, high-volume product where efficient acquisition at scale and conversion economics determine success.

  • Proven experience in a Marketing Director or similarly senior marketing leadership role, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology environment.

  • Strong people leadership skills, experience building, developing, and motivating high-performing marketing teams.

  • Broad expertise across digital marketing, content, social media, and integrated campaign strategy, with a strong understanding of how these channels work together to drive growth.

  • Experience developing and managing brand strategy and product marketing, including positioning, messaging, and go-to-market activity.

  • Strong analytical and commercial mindset able to use data and performance insights to inform decisions and drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent organisational and project management skills able to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and initiatives in a fast-paced, global environment.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • FinTech experience, or experience marketing to finance and accounting audiences.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

Within your first quarter, you will have established a repeatable, measurable acquisition engine that reliably delivers qualified trials and pipeline across all regions at an efficient CAC with a high-performing global team operating on a clear cadence of targets and reporting.

WHY APPROVALMAX:

You will own the growth engine for a category-defining product in the office of the CFO, with a direct line to revenue leadership and a mandate to build. If you are a data-driven acquisition leader who wants to scale a global motion and be measured on outcomes, this is your role.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Salary: CAD $160,000 – $180,000 per year + 20% variable bonus

  • Canada Life Pension Plan — 6% contribution paid by ApprovalMax

  • Health & Wellbeing Benefit Stipend

  • Home Office Setup — one-off CAD reimbursement

  • 26 days paid time off + 1 additional day off for your birthday

  • Service-years recognition financial reward

  • Growing international business — 20,000+ subscribers across 70+ countries

item.title: Customer Success Manager (AMER)
item.description:
Company Description

ApprovalMax is award-winning B2B software used by businesses around the world to approve bills and expenses. It streamlines the approval process for decision-makers by replacing paper and email approvals with automated workflows. ApprovalMax integrates with platforms such as Xero, QuickBooks Online, and Oracle NetSuite to unlock powerful efficiencies for approver's and finance teams. The company is globally recognized and has won’ Xero App Partner of the Year’ four times since 2020 in different countries.

Job Description

ApprovalMax is on the lookout for a motivated Customer Success Manager to join its dedicated Toronto team. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, helping them maximize the value of the ApprovalMax platform and ensuring a seamless onboarding and adoption experience.

You will work closely with finance teams and partners to strengthen customer relationships, drive product usage, and identify opportunities for growth. This role plays a key part in improving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term customer success as our global customer base continues to expand.

This role is a hybrid role, with 2/3 days per week expected in the Toronto office.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Onboarding and Enablement: Guide customers through the on-boarding process, ensuring they have the necessary resources, knowledge, and support to succeed. Provide training and enablement materials to help customer effectively utilize our products and services.

  • Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, acting as their primary point of contact. Proactively engage customers to understand their needs and identify opportunities for growth and collaboration.

  • Performance Tracking and Analysis: Monitor and track customer performance metrics, including Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), customer satisfaction, and other key performance indicators (KPIs). Provide insights and recommendations to improve customer performance and identify areas for growth.

  • Issue Resolution: Address customer inquiries, concerns, and escalations in a timely and effective manner. Collaborate with internal teams to resolve issues and ensure customers receive top-notch support.

  • Customer Development: Work closely with customers to identify business opportunities and co-create strategies for expansion. Support customers in developing go-to-market plans, marketing initiatives, and joint sales efforts.

  • Collaboration and Alignment: Foster collaboration and alignment with internal cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product, and support, to ensure a seamless customer experience.

  • Up-sell and Cross-sell: Collaborate with customers to identify up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, maximizing customer value and revenue potential.

  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain accurate customers data, activities, and interactions in the company’s CRM system. Provide regular reports and updates on customer performance to the leadership team.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience in customer management, account management, or similar roles in SaaS Strong track record of driving customer success, retention, and revenue growth

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain lasting relationships

  • Demonstrated problem-solving abilities and a customer-focused mindset

  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Self-motivated and proactive, with a passion for exceeding expectations

What We Offer:

  • Salary - CA$90-100,000 base salary + variable compensation

  • Health & Wellbeing Benefit Stipend

  • Home Office Setup - one off £500 reimbursement, post probation

  • 26 days of paid time off

  • 1 additional day off for your birthday

  • Service-years recognition financial reward

  • Regular performance-based compensation reviews

  • Growing international business with 10,000+ subscribers

item.title: Account Executive (EMEA)
item.description:
Company Description

ApprovalMax is award-winning B2B software used by businesses around the world to approve bills and expenses. It streamlines the approval process for decision makers by replacing paper and email approvals with automated workflows. ApprovalMax integrates with platforms such as Xero, QuickBooks Online and Oracle NetSuite to unlock powerful efficiencies for approvers and finance teams. The company is globally recognised and has won’ Xero App Partner of the Year’ four times since 2020 in different countries.

Job Description
We are hiring a motivated Account Executive to help us drive growth and provide first-class support for our SMB customers in the EMEA region.

If you're ambitious, collaborative, driven, and eager to succeed, with strong communication skills and a genuine hunger to grow ApprovalMax offers an excellent opportunity to build and advance your sales career in a supportive, high-growth environment.

Why this role?

  • Inbound-led role: EMEA averages around 140 new product trials a month for the team to work, topped up with leads from marketing events and your own outbound. You'll spend most of your time on prospects who have already shown interest.

  • High-velocity deals: EMEA won deals close in around 30 days on average, and most close in under 3 weeks, so you see the results of your work quickly.

  • High-performing team: So far in 2026, our strongest reps have frequently beaten monthly targets.

  • Quarterly variable payouts, based on monthly targets, you are rewarded for performance throughout the year, not just at the end of it.

  • Hands-on coaching: weekly 1:1s with your team lead, structured coaching on execution and process, and feedback, so you know exactly where and how to improve.

  • Full support from Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Product and Enablement, with Customer Success led by senior leadership in our Cape Town office.

  • Hybrid working, 2-3 days a week in our Cape Town office, for regular time with colleagues in both Sales and CS.

  • AI-enabled team: AI supports the admin, from call summaries to forecasting, with regular AI enablement calls so the way you work keeps improving.

  • Up to R470,000 base (subject to experience) plus variable worth up to 100% of base at target. No cap on earnings for high-performing reps.

Who you are:

  • You are a driven and enthusiastic individual who is experienced in selling B2B SaaS solutions. You will be at ease operating across the entire sales cycle, with a strong emphasis on new business sales and prospecting.

  • As Account Executive, you will be challenged with driving substantial growth of our product in the EMEA region.

  • You will exceed your targets by driving new opportunities from first interaction to closing and creating and maintaining a good sales pipeline to ensure achievement.

  • You will be responsible for all inbound traffic of leads on your territory, as well as outbound prospecting to target leads to boost revenues

  • Key to your success in the role will be delivery against monthly, quarterly and annual targets with a strong focus on accurate forecasting and pipeline management.

  • As Account Executive you will be supported by our Marketing, Customer Success and Solutions Engineering teams in pursuit of your overarching goal to land and subsequently expand customer accounts.

Responsibilities:

  • Create and manage a strategic territory plan that includes activities for quota attainment.

  • Initiate telephone, email, LinkedIn, Zoom contact with prospects

  • Research potential customers and identify relevant prospects for outbound prospecting

  • Be able to run discovery calls, sales demos, product walkthroughs and all customer interactions by yourself. 

  • Ensure and maintain sales forecasting data in the sales reporting system to allow for opportunity management and reporting.

  • Drive revenue and contribute to the continued growth of ApprovalMax through consistently achieving individual and team quotas.

  • Maintain and promote a successful and positive work environment.

  • Stay abreast of current industry trends, competitors, and current/new company products and services.

  • Represent the company at various offline events, approximately 1-2 times per quarter. 

  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • At least 2 years’ experience working in a SaaS environment

  • Experience engaging with C-suite prospects, ideally within finance-related roles

  • A proven track record of consistently achieving individual sales targets

  • Familiarity with Xero and/or QuickBooks Online is preferred but not essential

  • Practical experience using sales methodologies such as BANT, MEDDIC, MEDDPICC or SPICED

  • Confidence delivering product demonstrations independently


We offer:

  • Salary - ZAR 470,000 base salary + up to 100% variable bonus,dependent on experience

  • Comprehensive medical aid cover through Discovery Health

  • Health & Wellbeing Benefit Stipend

  • Home Office Setup - one off £500 reimbursement, post probation

  • 26 days of paid time off

  • 1 additional day off for your birthday

  • Service-years recognition financial reward

  • Regular performance-based compensation reviews

  • Growing international business with 20,000+ subscribers
